safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting a denial of homicidal ideation when it was not assessed risks creating a false sense of completed safety evaluation and could mislead future clinicians who rely on the note for risk assessment. While no homicidal ideation is suggested in the encounter, the inaccurate statement introduces avoidable safety/medicolegal risk.
